mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, conditions are clear near Reddan Soccer Park, with an overnight low of 61 degrees and no rain in the forecast for tonight.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new long-range guide was developed with extensive community input to ensure our city grows with sustainable housing, strong local employment, and vibrant public spaces.

There is plenty to do in town over the next couple of days. You can catch a yoga class today at Insight Wellness, while tomorrow is packed with options including Hop Haus trivia and the Quizmasters competition at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident from October 3, a 19-year-old man was arrested by the Verona Police Department after they were tipped off by Cottage Grove police regarding a stolen firearm case.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Flavor of the Day, which is Georgia Peach. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10 PM tonight.
